issues.desc: background.md Key Insights section uses the term "P5 ENV family" without defining what P5 means (priority level? a test category label?) or what the ENV family covers. A new reader cannot determine the significance of this deferral classification.

background.md references cross-story IDs B-ed12 and B-2d6c (in Key Insights and Conversational Texture) without a one-sentence explanation of what each story was about, making these pointers opaque to a reader without conversation history.

index.json type is "chore" but the description repeatedly uses the word "fix" and the story resolves failing test regressions. "fix" would more accurately classify a correctness bug in test isolation; "chore" typically denotes zero-functional-impact maintenance.
